messages:
samir: Tiny brag: we just surpassed 500k daily requests and closed a mid-market Dedicated deal overnight. Micro celebration? Tea + tiny gong at 2:30? :tea:
zoe: Wow!! Huge congrats. I'll bring biscuits and a paper banner.
maya: I'll make a simple slide for the weekly all-hands screenshot. Can someone write 1 line shoutout for infra?
li: Shoutout: "Massive thanks to eng-runtime & infra for stabilizing the partner rollout."
ops-bot: metrics: today peak 509,421 requests; error rate 0.03%; p99 210ms all nominal
zoe: Poll: paper banner colors — teal or coral? Reply with "teal" or "coral"
samir: teal
maya: coral (but teal is fine)
li: teal wins 2-1.
commspulse: Draft announce: "Partner launch steady; milestone: 500k daily requests. Internal cheers to infra, runtime, sales, and onboarding teams." Flagging legal for external wording.
zoe: I'll tape the banner near the kettle. Also who wants stickers? I ordered a small batch: "Serving Wins" sticker sheets. DM me "stickers"
maya: DMed. Also quick photo op at 2:40 for remote folks.
samir: Please keep contract details internal per legal. Use "partner launch" externally.
ops-bot: kitchen reserved 2:20-2:45. Keep it brief.
li: Remote folks: we'll livestream 15s of the gong and upload pics to #team-photos.
zoe: :partyparrot:
commspulse: Internal post scheduled. Congrats team!
ops-bot: nightly-backup: snapshot completed at 01:10 UTC — backups healthy.
